groups.title: Lock seamer for round duct — ISITAN
groups.lead: The LS-13P pneumatic lock seaming machine that closes the longitudinal seam of round ducts and pipes.

intro_add: At the bottom of the page, ISITAN's LS-13P pneumatic lock seamer, made in Turkey, closes the longitudinal lock seam of round ducts and pipes from Ø3.9 to 5.1″ in 18 ga, up to 51″ long.
points_add: ISITAN LS-13P pneumatic lock seamer: round-duct seams to 51.2″ long in 18 ga, Ø3.9 – 5.1″

set.hero_brand_line: NovoTech's value-line HVAC machines are built in China to NovoTech's specification; the LS-13P lock seamer is made in Turkey by ISITAN Makine. All sold, installed and supported in Canada by NovoTech.
